title: Utrecht’s Vredenburg is the busiest cycle path in all of the Netherlands
summary: A short Streetfilms montage of Vredenburg in Utrecht, a car-free street carrying about 33,000 cyclists a day. It shows heavy bike traffic alongside pedestrians and buses.
why: Cited as a visual example of what bike-first infrastructure looks like, including how few helmets are worn.

quote.text: And if you want to see what the alternative could look like, take a look at this video
